South Milwaukee Critical Mass

South Milwaukee, WI · Social

South Milwaukee Critical Mass is a social group ride in South Milwaukee, WI. It rolls last Friday of the month at 6:00 pm from Bucyrus Commons. Pace: slow, easy cruise.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: slow, easy cruise.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the South Milwaukee Critical Mass group ride

A slow monthly cruise around South Milwaukee. Meets at Bucyrus Commons. Listed on the Milwaukee Bike Rides community directory.
